title: Shared definitions of the Suderra edge contract

timestamp.description: UTC instant with second precision and a literal Z, e.g. 2026-10-20T12:00:00Z. Fractional seconds and offsets are not allowed, so TypeScript producers strip toISOString()'s .000.

digest.description: Digest set; contract 1.x defines sha256 only.

semver.description: Path-safe semantic version (DEC-1.10): it is used as a path component, so build metadata and empty identifiers are rejected.

board_profile.description: Board vocabulary; must equal the board_profile set of boards.json.

device_binding.description: Hash of the OS-owned hardware identity (DEC-3.6): SHA-256 of the TPM EK public key, or SHA-256(BCM2711 serial || customer OTP value) on TPM-less RPi4/CM4, or SHA-256 of the DMI product_uuid on TPM-less x86 dev images only.

sequence.description: Monotonic per device and statement kind; root keeps the last accepted value in /data/suderra/os/seq/<kind> (DEC-2.4).

keyid.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

lifecycle_state.description: Root-owned lifecycle states (DEC-12); LOCKED is the fail-safe reading of an unknown, missing, corrupt or unmountable state.
